info.about: ECW Anarchy Rulz is a professional wrestling video game released by Acclaim Entertainment in 2000 based on Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). It was released for the PlayStation and Dreamcast.
info.trivia: It was the last ECW game, made before the promotion filed for bankruptcy and was bought by WWE, and a planned Nintendo 64 version was cancelled.
info.why: The ECW licence ended with the promotion's bankruptcy, which left this as the final ECW game, and wrestling collectors chase the Dreamcast disc.
